ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.error: The ranking could not be updated. Try again.
ranking.noTierMatches: No ordered works match these filters.
ranking.filteredUnplacedEmpty: Unplaced works are hidden by these filters.
ranking.finishPlacementFirst: Place the unplaced works before starting regular duels.
ranking.filteredDuelsNeedTwo: At least two placed works must match the current filters.
ranking.needSecondFilteredWork: Choose filters that include at least two unplaced works to compare.
ranking.tierListLabel: All score tiers and their ordered works
ranking.plannedGroupDescription: Works you plan to experience later.
ranking.droppedGroupDescription: Works you started and decided to leave.
ranking.sidebarDropTarget: Drop here to rate {score} out of 10 and leave unplaced
ranking.startDuelsForTier: Start duels in the {score} out of 10 tier
ranking.emptyPlacedHint: Drop here to rate and place.
ranking.unplacedDropTarget: Drop rated work here to keep it unplaced in {score} out of 10
ranking.unplacedDropHint: Drop rated work here to leave it unplaced.
ranking.binarySuggestion: Most works in this tier already have a place. Want to find “{title}” a spot with a few quick comparisons?
ranking.placeAtTop: Place {title} at the top of this tier
ranking.placeAtBottom: Place {title} at the bottom of this tier
ranking.unratedDescription: Experienced works without an overall score. Drag one onto a tier to give it a score.
ranking.dropToRate: Drag {title} onto a score tier to rate it
ranking.unratedDragHint: Dropping into the ordered row sets the score and places it there. Dropping into a tier’s unplaced tray sets the score and leaves it waiting for a place.
ranking.seedQuestion: Which of these two works do you prefer?
ranking.seedStartNote: Choose between two works to begin their shared order. The other unplaced works will stay in the tier.
ranking.singlePlacedStartNote: A quick duel can place one unplaced work beside the work already here, then continue with regular comparisons.
ranking.binaryOfferBody: Choose another unplaced work for a quick placement, or return to the tier list.
ranking.binaryQuestion: Which work belongs higher in this tier?
ranking.normalQuestion: Which work do you prefer in this score tier?
ranking.duelsHeading: A few quick choices can refine your order
ranking.duelsIntro: Compare two works you have experienced. Your choices help refine the same tier list you can edit yourself.
ranking.subsetDescription: Regular duels compare a selected group of works.
ranking.subsetPrompt: Choose 2–200 placed works for this duel session. Their order in the tier list is preserved.
ranking.subsetEmpty: No placed works match your search.
ranking.subsetNeeded: Choose a subset of 200 or fewer placed works to start regular duels.
ranking.subsetTooSmall: Choose at least two placed works to start regular duels.
ranking.invalidSubset: Choose placed works from this score tier for the duel subset.
ranking.subsetBinaryConflict: Choose a subset only for regular duels. Binary placement uses the full tier order.
ranking.fastDuelsNote: Each choice is saved right away. You can pause or leave whenever you like.
ranking.needTwoPlaced: Add or rate at least two works in this tier to compare them. You can place a single work directly with its arrow controls.
ranking.sessionComplete: Your choices are saved and the shared order can keep improving over time.
ranking.sessionRestarted: Your tier changed, so Duels restarted with the latest order.
ranking.duelRestartFailed: Duels could not restart. Your tier list is saved; choose Start duels to continue.
ranking.orderChanged: Your choice changed the shared order.
ranking.confirmPlacementBody: The quick comparisons suggest this place in the {score} out of 10 tier. You can adjust the order afterward.
ranking.tierHelpDescription: Your score and your within-tier order say different useful things.
ranking.tierHelpBody: The score captures your overall rating. The order helps show which works you like more when they share a score.
ranking.tierHelpPointOne: Move works yourself whenever your opinion changes; the new place takes effect right away.
ranking.tierHelpPointTwo: More thoughtful comparisons can help Tastellar understand what you enjoy.
ranking.tierHelpPointThree: A clearer picture of your taste can make Recap and Analysis more useful.
ranking.duelHelpDescription: Small choices help Tastellar learn what you tend to enjoy.
ranking.duelHelpBody: A duel asks which of two works you prefer within the same score tier and changes their position in the tier list depending on your choice. There is no objective answer; go with the one you enjoy more overall.
ranking.duelHelpPointOne: Think about the story, world, characters, craft, or the feeling a work left with you.
ranking.duelHelpPointTwo: Each choice can refine the same tier list you edit by hand. You can switch between duels and the list whenever you like.
ranking.duelHelpPointThree: Over time, these choices can help Tastellar describe your taste more clearly in Recap and Analysis.
ranking.addWorkDescription: Add a work you have experienced, then give it an overall score or leave it unrated.
ranking.newRatedUnplaced: This work will appear in the tier’s “Not placed” tray. You can drag it into the order or find its place with duels.
